# astro-weights

> Agent-driven weight edits. Democratizing AI for all.

Python library. Agent proposes small low-rank edits to open LLM weights; edits that hold up under paired tests get saved as plain PEFT LoRA adapters. Pre-alpha, Apache-2.0. Install: `pip install astro-weights`.
